title: Perform Daily Maintenance Checklist: Operator Station, Chute, Stacklights, Guards, and QR Codes
summary: Complete the daily inspection items to confirm the Operator Station controller/chute are intact and that stacklights, guards, and QR codes are in good condition.
when_to_use: Use this daily, on-site inspection checklist to verify the Operator Station controller, Operator Station chute, stacklights, guards/attaching hardware, and QR codes (floor and racks) are in acceptable condition before operation.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the on-site visual inspections and record results on the Daily Maintenance Checklist form.
safety_notes: Follow site safety practices while inspecting physical equipment (controller, chute area, guards, and QR code locations).
access_or_tools_needed: On-site access to the Operator Station controller, chute, stacklights, guards, and QR codes

access_required: On-site access to the Operator Station controller, chute, stacklights, guards, and QR codes

visual_references.description: Controller PCA diagram (used here only as a visual reference for the controller assembly location/components; the daily checklist step is to inspect the Operator Station controller for damage).
Rotary station photo under the chute (optional visual reference for the chute/station area context while performing the chute debris inspection).

Operator Station HMI Heartbeat Stats screen (not required by the daily checklist excerpt; included only if your site uses HMI indicators as part of determining 'operational' stacklight/overall station health—no explicit daily checklist criteria provided in the excerpt).
Operator station HMI screen 'Visu_MDs' (F2) (not required by the daily checklist excerpt; included only as an optional visual reference for operator station HMI context).

steps.title: Record inspection date, inspected by, and unit inspected
steps.purpose: Ensure the daily checklist is properly logged for traceability.
steps.instruction: On the Daily Maintenance Checklist form, record the Inspection Date, Inspected By, and Unit Inspected.
steps.expected_result: The form has entries for Inspection Date, Inspected By, and Unit Inspected.
steps.healthy_condition: All three fields are completed (no blanks).
steps.failure_condition: Any of the three fields are missing or left blank.

actions.label: Fill checklist header fields
actions.exact_action: Record Inspection Date, Inspected By, and Unit Inspected on the Daily Maintenance Checklist form.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Daily Maintenance Checklist form includes: Inspection Date, Inspected By, Unit Inspected.

steps.title: Inspect the Operator Station controller for damage
steps.purpose: Confirm the controller is intact and safe to use.
steps.instruction: Visually inspect the Operator Station controller for damage.
steps.expected_result: No damage is observed on the Operator Station controller.
steps.healthy_condition: Controller appears intact with no visible damage.
steps.failure_condition: Damage is observed on the Operator Station controller.

actions.label: Visual inspection: controller
actions.exact_action: Inspect the Operator Station controller for damage.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the controller shows damage, stop the checklist and escalate for corrective action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Checklist item: □ Inspect the Operator Station controller for damage.

steps.title: Ensure the Operator Station chute is free of debris
steps.purpose: Prevent obstruction or unsafe conditions caused by debris in the chute area.
steps.instruction: Visually check the Operator Station chute area and ensure it is free of debris.
steps.expected_result: No debris is present in the Operator Station chute.
steps.healthy_condition: Chute interior/entry area is clear of debris.
steps.failure_condition: Debris is present in the Operator Station chute.

actions.label: Visual inspection: chute
actions.exact_action: Ensure the Operator Station chute is free of debris.

stop_or_escalate_if: If debris is found, stop the checklist and escalate for corrective action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Checklist item: □ Ensure Operator Station chute is free of debris.

steps.title: Verify stacklights are operational
steps.purpose: Confirm stacklight indication is functioning for safe/visible status signaling.
steps.expected_result: Stacklights are operational (as determined by your site’s operational check for stacklights).
steps.healthy_condition: Stacklights indicate normal/operational condition (no failure observed).
stop_or_escalate_if: If stacklights are not operational, stop the checklist and escalate for corrective action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Checklist item: □ Verify stacklights are operational.

steps.title: Inspect guards and verify attaching hardware is secure
steps.purpose: Ensure guards are properly installed and secured to prevent hazards.
steps.instruction: Inspect the guards and verify the attaching hardware is secure.
steps.expected_result: Guards are intact and attaching hardware is secure.
steps.healthy_condition: No loose/incorrectly secured attaching hardware is observed.
steps.failure_condition: Attaching hardware is not secure or guards appear damaged/incorrectly secured.

actions.label: Inspect guards & hardware
actions.exact_action: Inspect the guards and verify attaching hardware is secure.

stop_or_escalate_if: If guards or attaching hardware are damaged/not secure, stop the checklist and escalate for corrective action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Checklist item: □ Inspect the guards and verify attaching hardware is secure.

steps.title: Inspect all QR codes on the floor for damage or peeling
steps.purpose: Ensure floor QR codes are readable and not physically degraded.
steps.instruction: Inspect all QR codes on the floor for damage or peeling.
steps.expected_result: All floor QR codes show no damage and no peeling.
steps.healthy_condition: QR code labels appear intact (no peeling/damage observed).
steps.failure_condition: Any floor QR code shows damage or peeling.

actions.label: Inspect floor QR codes
actions.exact_action: Inspect all QR codes on the floor for damage or peeling.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any floor QR code is damaged or peeling, stop the checklist and escalate for corrective action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Checklist item: □ Inspect all QR codes on the floor for damage or peeling.

steps.title: Inspect all QR codes on the racks for damage or peeling
steps.purpose: Ensure rack QR codes are readable and not physically degraded.
steps.instruction: Inspect all QR codes on the racks for damage or peeling.
steps.expected_result: All rack QR codes show no damage and no peeling.
steps.healthy_condition: QR code labels appear intact (no peeling/damage observed).
steps.failure_condition: Any rack QR code shows damage or peeling.

actions.label: Inspect rack QR codes
actions.exact_action: Inspect all QR codes on the racks for damage or peeling.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any rack QR code is damaged or peeling, stop the checklist and escalate for corrective action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Checklist item: □ Inspect all QR codes on the racks for damage or peeling.

success_criteria: Operator Station controller shows no damage
Operator Station chute is free of debris
All floor QR codes show no damage or peeling
All rack QR codes show no damage or peeling
healthy_conditions: Operator Station controller has no visible damage
Operator Station chute has no debris
Guards are intact and attaching hardware is secure
Floor QR codes show no damage or peeling
Rack QR codes show no damage or peeling
failure_conditions: Any floor QR code is damaged or peeling
Any rack QR code is damaged or peeling
escalation_guidance: If any item shows damage (controller, guards/attaching hardware, QR codes) or stacklights are not operational, stop the checklist and escalate for corrective action.
